candidate_independent_evidence_design.purpose: Create a new nonreused evidence set whose race assignment and predictions are frozen before any outcome access.
candidate_independent_evidence_design.selection_rule_draft: Use a future calendar window strictly after the R0_T2 freeze. Include races only when PRE/racecard inputs needed by the frozen score are available before race start. Select by deterministic chronological ordering with no outcome-aware filtering. Exact dates, venue scope, minimum race count, exclusions, and source identifiers must be frozen in the final preregistration before any eligible outcome is accessed.
candidate_independent_evidence_design.prediction_lock: For each assigned race, serialize race identity, frozen input/source hashes, participant set, frozen R0_T2 probabilities, ordered top-3 probabilities, timestamp, and implementation hash before result access.
candidate_independent_evidence_design.result_firewall: No result, payout, odds/price, economics, ROI or profit data may be accessed by the evaluation path until the final preregistration is canonical and a new exact Owner Gate authorizes one-shot scoring.
candidate_independent_evidence_design.no_evidence_substitution: If the exact assigned set is unavailable or incomplete, fail closed and create a new versioned preregistration; do not substitute races after observing outcomes.

frozen_metric_candidate.uncertainty: 10,000-replicate race bootstrap with seed fixed in final preregistration; if multiple meetings are represented, also meeting-block bootstrap with a separately fixed seed.
frozen_metric_candidate.pass_logic_draft: Primary improvement must be positive with its preregistered bootstrap lower 95% bound above zero; winner log-loss and Brier must not be worse than uniform; calibration must remain finite and within the final preregistered ceiling. Exact thresholds are not final until the final preregistration is frozen before outcome access.

stop_conditions: Any overlap with Gate #487 A+B evidence or any previously observed outcome set => STOP.
Any need to deserialize DEV2000_C or ECON_HOLDOUT1000 outcomes => STOP.
Any model, temperature, scoring formula, metric, threshold, race-selection rule, or parser change after first eligible outcome access => STOP and version a new lineage.
Any missing exact Owner Gate before result scoring => STOP.
Any ambiguity about evidence independence or access chronology => FAIL CLOSED.
required_before_final_preregistration: Fresh-read canonical main, Control #394, Keirin #377, active branch CURRENT/RULE/LEDGER.
Freeze exact future evidence assignment using PRE-only/public metadata without outcome access.
Freeze bootstrap seeds, exact thresholds, minimum sample and meeting requirements, and missing-data policy.
Record an evidence-independence/collision audit against all consumed/exposed Keirin validation sets.
Create a new exact Owner Gate request limited to one-shot result scoring of the frozen evidence set.
